jobAdDetails.title: Data Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
You're a data engineer who builds and maintains reliable pipelines that turn raw commercial and operational data into trusted, queryable datasets. You bring hands-on experience with modern ELT tooling and a track record of shipping pipelines that hold up under production load. This role exists to make sure every team at Qogita can trust the data they build on.

The Data Engineering team owns the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data across Qogita's platform, working closely with Analytics, Product, Science, and Engineering to keep the data warehouse accurate and available.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• Build and maintain ELT pipelines that move data from Qogita's production systems into the data warehouse.
  • Manage the modeling layer in dbt, ensuring transformations are tested, documented, and performant at scale.
  • Deliver new datasets and metrics in partnership with Analytics and Product to support cross-functional reporting needs.
  • Own the monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures and data quality issues, resolving incidents before they reach downstream consumers.
  • Analyse query performance and warehouse costs, and improve schema design and partitioning strategy accordingly.
  • Develop internal tooling and documentation that make the data platform easier for other engineers to use.
  • Work as part of the platform team, partnering with ot
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
• 3+ years of experience building production data pipelines with a modern ELT stack.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and Python, applied to pipeline development and data validation.
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster.
  • Able to work independently with minimal guidance and identify data quality issues before they affect downstream teams.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving scale-up environment with evolving priorities.
jobAdDetails.benefits:
• Base salary: €60,000 – €75,000 
  • 26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days
  • Company performance-based bonus
  • Attractive equity package
  • Pension contributions
  • Annual learning & development budget
  • Office-led culture with hybrid flexibility
  • Dog-friendly offices
  • Home-office setup package
  • Office socials and annual company-wide offsite

jobAdDetails.title: Business Development Intern - Spanish Speaking | PM Hours
jobAdDetails.description:
The Business Development team is responsible for acquiring new customers across Qogita's markets, from initial engagement through to first order.

As a Business Development Intern, you will help facilitate inbound opportunities from the US market. You will speak with prospective buyers, understand their business and purchasing needs, identify where Qogita can add value, and support them through to their first order. You will work primarily with US customers, starting your working day at 14:00 to align with US business hours. Fluency in Spanish is required to support Spanish-speaking customers across the market. This role suits someone who is commercially minded, confident in customer conversations, and comfortable taking responsibility for moving opportunities forward.<
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• Support inbound qualification: Help review and qualify inbound leads from retailers, pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors in the US market against our target customer criteria.
  • Engage with leads: Respond to inbound enquiries across calls, email and chat, helping turn initial interest into qualified opportunities for the Business Development team.
  • Keep our CRM up to date: Maintain accurate lead and pipeline information

jobAdDetails.title: New Ventures Intern (Business Development)
jobAdDetails.description:
The Business Development team drives new customer acquisition across Europe and the UK - identifying, qualifying, and converting Health & Beauty buyers into active Qogita customers. As part of the team, you’ll also have exposure to Qogita’s New Ventures work, our internal venture-building engine exploring new markets, product categories, and business opportunities.

As a New Ventures Intern (Business Development), your mission is to support the team in building and converting the customer pipeline while gaining hands-on exposure to how new business opportunities are identified, tested, and developed. You’ll build core commercial skills across B2B sales, customer acquisition, market research, and early-stage venture building - giving you a strong foundation for a career in sales,
